title: Imp Jar Select Spearmint 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Imp Jar Select Spearmint is a delicate and refreshing herbal blend. It recreates the sweet, fragrant, and slightly floral flavour of garden Spearmint, finishing with a subtle fresh aftertaste. It is a perfect palate cleanser for all-day vaping. The Imp Jar Select nic salt range utilise twice as much flavour concentrate as standard e-liquids for an intense flavour payoff which pairs perfectly with starter kits and refillable pod kits. Launched in conjunction with Imp Jar's first pod vape kit, the Imp Jar Select, Imp Jar Select Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, allowing you to tailor your vaping experience. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
